title: Pocketwire Personal Account Terms: Closing the Account
content:
1. Closing the Pocketwire Personal Account is the customer's own decision and is confirmed by the customer in the app, which moves the account to closure pending; the customer may withdraw it while it is still pending.
2. A closure completes only when the ledger balance is 0.00 and no claim on the account is still pending; the customer moves any remaining balance out by cash-out first, and a pending claim keeps the account in closure pending until it is resolved. Both conditions are read from the system records of the account and its claims.
3. A customer who holds an open Pocketwire Business Profile or an open Pocketwire Advance line must close those first, because both are linked to the personal account.
4. A closed account cannot be reopened; the customer may open a new account under the one-account-per-person rule of the Pocketwire Personal Account.

**Completion of a pending closure** (term 2 is a complete condition)

| Ledger balance | Claim still pending on the account | Closure completes? |
|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | No | Yes |
| 0.00 | Yes | No — the account stays closure pending until the claim is resolved |
| Any figure other than 0.00 | No or yes | No |

**Basis questions**

- *Who starts a closure?* Only the customer, confirming it in the app.
- *Can a pending closure be undone?* Yes, by the customer, while it is still pending; the account returns to active.
- *Can a closed account be reopened?* No; a new account may be opened instead.
